records.title: It Helps to Take a Second Opinion: Teaching Smaller LLMs to Deliberate Mutually via Selective Rationale Optimisation
records.reason: Selective Rationale Optimisation trains smaller models to deliberate; its contribution is model training, not inference/serving/compression.

records.title: TokenSwap: A Lightweight Method to Disrupt Memorized Sequences in LLMs
records.reason: TokenSwap targets memorized-sequence privacy/unlearning behavior, not resource or inference efficiency.

records.title: Leveraging Text-to-Text Transformers as Classifier Chain for Few-Shot Multi-Label Classification
records.reason: The paper distills a T5 classifier chain for multi-label classification; it is task-specific classifier training rather than a general inference efficiency method.

records.title: Bag of Tricks for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts: A Benchmark Across Reasoning, Efficiency, and Safety
records.reason: The checked evidence emphasizes training/fine-tuning and architecture metrics, not inference latency, serving throughput, or compression/runtime implementation; fit to an inference/serving survey is weak.

records.title: SHF: Symmetrical Hierarchical Forest with Pretrained Vision Transformer Encoder for High-Resolution Medical Segmentation
records.reason: SHF is a ViT architecture for medical-image segmentation, not language-model inference/serving.
